size.$description: dimension used by the status component for the dot: the MarsUI 4px dot, Space/xs bound to every Status variant (specs/021-ki-status/design-extraction.md). One size per theme, never an attribute (FR-006).

radius.$description: dimension used by the status component for the dot shape: Radius/radius_round bound in Figma — the round dot is a radius token, never an attribute (002 shape precedent).

shadow.$description: shadow used by the status component for the dot effects: the exact MarsUI pair on every Status variant — e1 drop (0/1/1/-0.5 in the scheme shadow color) plus inner White/12 highlight (0/3/3), i.e. Component_effect/primary_default's box-shadow layers, flat in onmars v2. Its backdrop blur is not applied: a 4px dot has nothing to blur (brief §5 perf note).

ring-width.$description: dimension used by the status component for the separating ring: the 2px stroke on every Outline=True Status variant (FR-002).

ring-color.$description: color used by the status component for the separating ring: Outline/inverse_black, the exact variable bound to Outline=True variants — white over light surfaces, black over dark ones, so the ring reads as a cutout from the underlying media (FR-002).

neutral-color.$description: color used by the status component for the neutral tone fill: ki.outline.control, the semantic 3:1 non-text floor (Black/48 light, White/48 dark; md.sys.color.outline in material3) — a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI binding Surface/disabled_high_em (Gray/500 light, White/32 dark), which reads 2.10:1 and 2.78:1 against the page where WCAG 1.4.11 asks 3:1 of the dot (FR-008). MarsUI's disabled gray still maps to the charter neutral tone (spec Assumptions).

success-color.$description: color used by the status component for the success tone fill: Surface/success_med_em, the exact variable bound to the Type=success Status variant (Success/500).

danger-color.$description: color used by the status component for the danger tone fill: Surface/danger_med_em, the exact variable bound to the Type=danger Status variant (Danger/500).

info-color.$description: color used by the status component for the info tone fill: Surface/info_high_em (Info/600 light, Info/400 dark) — one step above the med-em 500 pattern the success and danger tones follow, because Info/500 reads 2.29:1 on the light page and WCAG 1.4.11 asks 3:1 of the dot (FR-008). No Figma Status variant ships an info Type, so the fill remains an extrapolation onto the Info ramp (001 contract, 010/015 precedent) declared for founder ratification.

warning-color.$description: color used by the status component for the warning tone fill: Text/warning_high_em (Warning/800 light, Warning/300 dark) — a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI binding Surface/warning_med_em (Warning/500), which reads 1.92:1 on the light page. No warning surface step clears the 3:1 WCAG 1.4.11 asks of the dot (Warning/600 reads 2.33:1), so the fill takes the warning ink that is legible on the page (FR-008).
